_about.weapons: the game's weapon tables (build_weapons.py): [data manager +0x94] = 0xba353c, one per class, 0x1c-byte records (0x64 for the Heavy Bowgun, Light Bowgun and Bow), read through 0x8939a0; `model` = record +0, which the game's own getter 0x8949c8 returns. Names: the class's message file at the record's index (Lsword_eng.gmd for the Great Sword ...), an index rule the counts and the DUMMY rows bear out but whose lookup is not traced; the files carry a few names past the tables, which no record reaches. Records 0 and DUMMY are left out.
_about.classes: `name` = Menu_eng.gmd 236 + class, in class order; `dir` and `parts` = the player loader's own names (0x8eebbc reads the class's array at 0xc76de8: part n is entry n, entry n + 1 for the Long Sword and Dual Blades), cut to the parts the cart ships.
_about.models: every weapon model on the cart, v flipped and ETC1A4 alpha replicated as for the armour; `hideIdx` = primitives whose mesh-table row lacks the draw bit (the proxy parts 100-102). Mounted on the hunter as mount.json says (mh3u_mount.py).
_about.pig: a weapon's pigment (the colour its colour-type-3 materials take): record +0x18, +9 for the Heavy Bowgun, Light Bowgun and Bow (0x894534), an index into `pigments`, the RGB table 0xb02924 that 0x893e48 reads. With index 0 the game passes the part's stored colour instead (cPlayerBase +0x58, 0x242328), whose value is not read; the viewer draws it as entry 0, white.
